PDF.js 4.10.38 (legacy build) by Mozilla — https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/ — Apache License 2.0, see LICENSE.
Used by "From documents" to turn the pages of a PDF into images on the user's own device.
Files are unmodified copies from the npm package "pdfjs-dist": legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs and legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs
(saved here with the extension .js, which every web host serves as JavaScript), standard_fonts/ and cmaps/. To update: copy the same files from a newer "pdfjs-dist" and run the browser checks (tests/e2e).
